requiredDocs: Employer confirmation or work contract (if available)
Calendar or log of home-office days
questions: On how many days did you work from home in this tax year?
Do you have a dedicated room used almost only for work?
description: Costs of working from home: days worked at home, a dedicated work room (Arbeitszimmer), and home-office running costs. Not equipment purchases (those are work_equipment).

requiredDocs: Invoice or receipt with purchase date and amount
questions: What share of the use is for work?
On what date was it bought?
description: Items bought mainly for work: laptop, computer, monitor, keyboard, desk, office chair, software, tools, work clothing, professional books.

requiredDocs: Number of working days at the workplace
questions: What is the one-way distance to work in km?
How many days did you commute?
description: Travel between home and the regular workplace: distance, working days, fuel or public-transport tickets for the daily commute.

questions: What was the expense for, and how is it connected to your income?
description: Other possibly deductible items for an employee: union fees, courses and training, donations, health costs, job-application costs, and similar.
